name: Miya Might Break
source:
A short psychological horror visual novel about routine, pressure, and losing control.

Miya can't survive without performing the ritual. That's why every night she performs the ritual to stay calm... But recently something or someone is watching her do it.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4238360/]Steam[/url]]
